question: Find the number of sides of a regular polygon, each of whose interior angles measures 162°
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ For any **regular polygon**, the sum of an **interior angle** and its corresponding **exterior angle** is 180°. Exterior angle = 180° − 162° = 18° The **number of sides (n)** is calculated as: n = 360° ÷ Exterior angle ⇒ n = 360° ÷ 18° = 20 **∴ The correct answer is 20 sides.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** **Given:** Each **interior angle** of a **regular polygon** = 162° **Formula Used:** Interior angle of a regular polygon = [(n − 2) × 180°] ÷ n [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3742c51ba734d0662988f0883ba11c33b02827cbe72bd53137bc0d26a7c59ae.png] **Calculations:** ⇒ 162° = [(n − 2) × 180°] ÷ n ⇒ 162n = 180n − 360 ⇒ 180n − 162n = 360 ⇒ 18n = 360 ⇒ n = 360 ÷ 18 ⇒ n = 20 **∴ The correct answer is 20 sides.**
